headline: Last session: Sensex fell 289 points as inflation concerns weighed, but markets logged a third weekly gain.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 17 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on market sentiment during Friday's session.
Markets extended their rally for the third straight week despite global pressures.
Foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices provided underlying support during the week.
PSU Banks led the sectoral gains in the weekly market wrap.
whatHappening: On the last trading day, Sensex dropped 289 points and Nifty slipped due to inflation worries.
Indian market benchmark indices NIFTY50 and SENSEX completed a third consecutive week of gains.
PSU Banks emerged as the top performing sectoral gainers over the past week.
Aayush Wellness expanded its product portfolio by entering the shilajit segment with Himalayan drops.
summary: The stock market is closed today for the weekend. In the last trading session on Friday, Sensex fell 289 points amid inflation concerns. However, both Sensex and Nifty managed to extend their weekly rally for the third consecutive week led by PSU bank gains.
